descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper name (אֲחַזְיָהוּ, 'YHWH has grasped') referring to two kings in the Hebrew Bible: (1) Ahaziah son of Ahab, king of Israel (1 Kgs 22:40,49; 2 Kgs 1), and (2) Ahaziah son of Jehoram, king of Judah (2 Kgs 8:24-29; 2 Chr 22). All three sense clusters are purely grammatical variants of the same proper noun — bare nominative, with prepositions (to/of Ahaziah), and with conjunction (and-Ahaziah). Multilingual renderings are uniform: spa 'Ocozias', arb 'أَخَزْيَا', hin 'अहज्याहू', kor '아하시야', swa 'Ahazia'.
